definitions.explanation: A cough that produces no phlegm. A non-productive cough.
A cough made on purpose to get someone's attention, signal discomfort, or cover an awkward silence.

examples.japanese: {空咳|からせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I can't stop my dry cough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{空咳|からせき}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: After my cold, only a dry cough remained.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{空咳|からせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。

examples.english: When the teacher gave a deliberate cough, the students fell silent.

notes:
{空咳|からせき} has two distinct meanings: a dry cough (medical) and a deliberate cough (social).

FORMS:
The prefix ⟦{空|から}→空：27640_kara⟧ means "empty" or "lacking content," as in {空|から}っぽ (empty) and ⟦{空振|からぶ}り→空振り：08587_karaburi⟧ (a swing and a miss). Here it indicates a cough with no phlegm, or a cough with no real need to cough.

MEDICAL SENSE:
A dry, non-productive cough. Contrasts with ⟦{痰|たん}→痰：17896_tan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絡|から}む→絡む：04366_karamu⟧⟦{咳|せき}→咳：12007_seki⟧ (a productive cough with phlegm). Common with colds, allergies, and dry air.

SOCIAL SENSE:
A deliberate cough used to get attention, signal discomfort, or break an awkward silence. The standard expression is {空咳|からせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {空咳|からせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to have a dry cough
- {空咳|からせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: can't stop coughing (dry)
- {空咳|からせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give a deliberate cough
